15 open-source Deezer projects built by reverse engineering

Open-source projects that exist because someone reverse engineered Deezer music streaming. 8 of 15 had a commit in the last 12 months. Most-starred: streamrip, muffon, refreezer, deezer-linux, syncedlyrics.
